lines.en: label amicamp1:
scene nightsky
I leave Makoto behind and start making my way home, equal parts exasperated and concerned.
lines.zh: 我把 Makoto 留在身后,踏上回家的路,一半恼火,一半担忧。

lines.en: For one, it’s relatively late and I have no idea whether or not Ami is even going to be awake by the time I get home.
lines.zh: 首先,时间不早了,我不知道到家时 Ami 还醒着没有。

lines.en: On top of that, though, how is this going to make me sound? And why am I even concerned about how I’m going to sound in the first place when all that should really matter is the effect it will have on her?
lines.zh: 除此之外,这件事会让我听起来像个什么样的人?而且,明明真正该在意的只有它对她的影响,我为什么首先要担心自己的形象?

lines.en: She’ll know right away that this isn’t my idea. And I know her, so I know it will make her concerned about how I landed on this. And she knows me so she’ll know I’ll be concerned as a result of that.
lines.zh: 她马上就会知道这不是我的主意。而我了解她,所以我知道她会为我怎么走到这一步而担忧。而她了解我,所以她会知道,她一担忧,我也会跟着担忧。

lines.en: Then, we can all be concerned together because that’s an important adjective beginning with the letter C (which rhymes with T) and I just want this day to be over.
lines.zh: 然后,我们就可以一起担忧了——毕竟这是个以字母 C 开头的重要形容词(和字母 T 押韵),而我就想让今天赶紧结束。

lines.en: scene black
Unfortunately, nothing ever ends when I want it to. It’s either long before or long after. Which means that either this night is going to last an extra several hours-
lines.zh: 遗憾的是,没有一件事在我希望结束的时候结束。要么早得多,要么晚得多。这意味着,要么今晚要多熬好几个小时——

lines.en: Or I am going to be hit by a car on the way home and Ami will be left with no one but a girl who only wants her because she shares my blood.
lines.zh: 要么我会在回家路上被车撞,而 Ami 将只剩下那个女孩——一个只因她流着我的血,才想要她的女孩。

lines.en: scene knockknockami1
I used to buy books for Ami when she was much smaller.
lines.zh: Ami 还小得多的时候,我常给她买书。

lines.en: I don’t know why I’m just now remembering that- but perhaps it has something to do with this door.
lines.zh: 我不知道为什么现在才想起来——但也许和这扇门有关。

lines.en: Come to think of it, there’s a verse that sticks out in my head when I look at it. But I can’t remember all of it, so I hope this much will do.
lines.zh: 细想起来,盯着它的时候,有一节诗浮现在我脑海。但我记不全了,希望这几句够用。

lines.en: The hallway of life is door upon door.
lines.zh: 人生的走廊,一扇门连着一扇门。

lines.en: Each door has a doorknob. Each opens to secrets.
lines.zh: 每扇门都有一个把手。每扇门都通往秘密。

lines.en: One secret. One doorknob.
lines.zh: 一个秘密。一个把手。

lines.en: Daily, I choose a doorway to walk through.
lines.zh: 每一天,我都选一扇门走进去。

lines.en: At times I’m confused for I know that each door is a new day to live, a new way to struggle, a new way to give.
lines.zh: 有时我困惑,因为我知道每扇门都是新的一天、新的挣扎、新的给予。

lines.en: I stand in this hall lined with doors, doors galore, knowing each doorway will open to more-
lines.zh: 我站在这条门廊里,门,多不胜数的门,深知每一扇门后还有更多——

lines.en: Seeking the one that will make me feel free-
lines.zh: 寻找那扇能让我感到自由的门——

lines.en: And turning a doorknob to find a new me...
lines.zh: 转动一个门把手,遇见一个新的自己……

lines.en: That’s what I hope to get out of this, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 这就是我想从这一切里得到的,不是吗?

lines.en: Maybe not right away, but I wouldn’t be putting the effort in at all if I wasn’t in search of a change, right?
lines.zh: 也许不会立刻实现,但如果不是在寻求改变,我根本不会费这份力气,对吧?

lines.en: Is there a new me behind this door?
lines.zh: 这扇门后,有一个新的我吗?

lines.en: Is she playing patty-cake with him? Or dressing him up in women’s clothes as he scoffs and pretends he isn’t enjoying it?
lines.zh: 她在和他拍手游戏吗?还是在把他打扮成女人,而他一边嗤之以鼻、一边假装并不享受?

lines.en: scene black
Or is it simply locked?
lines.zh: 还是它干脆锁着?

lines.en: : Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami?

lines.en: Maybe I’ll get lucky.
lines.zh: 也许我会走运。

lines.en: Maybe it will be empty.
lines.zh: 也许里面是空的。

lines.en: : Come in...
lines.zh: : 进来……

lines.en: scene knockknockami2
: Hey...sorry for bothering you so late.
lines.zh: : 嗨……这么晚打扰你,抱歉。

lines.en: : If you’re going to apologize to anyone, it should probably be Niki...I just got off the phone with her and she’s still mad about you leaving me alone.
lines.zh: : 你要道歉的话,对象应该是 Niki……我刚跟她通完电话,她还在为你丢下我一个人而生气。

lines.en: : And besides, you don’t ever have to apologize to me, Sensei. Especially now that I’ve hurt you.
lines.zh: : 再说了,你永远都不必向我道歉,Sensei。尤其是现在,是我伤了你。

lines.en: : It was barely a scratch, Ami. It healed within a few days.
lines.zh: : 那不过是道小口子,Ami。几天就愈合了。

lines.en: : Do you want to hurt me to make up for it? Because you can if you want. I deserve it.
lines.zh: : 你想伤回来赔罪吗?你想的话就可以。我活该。

lines.en: : I’m good. Do you have a few minutes to talk, though?
lines.zh: : 不必了。不过,你有几分钟时间聊聊吗?

lines.en: : I have all the time in the world. But what is it you want to talk about?
lines.zh: : 我有的是时间。但你想聊什么?

lines.en: : A few things, actually. And one of them involves Niki. But chances are I’ll tuck my tail between my legs and escape before I can even get to that part.
lines.zh: : 其实是几件事。其中一件涉及 Niki。但多半我会在讲到那部分之前,夹着尾巴溜走。

lines.en: : I’m...confused.
lines.zh: : 我……有点糊涂。

lines.en: scene knockknockami3
: Yeah...me too.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我也是。

lines.en: : But I’ve been confused a lot lately. And that’s not fair to you.
lines.zh: : 但我最近糊涂得很频繁。这对你不公平。

lines.en: : ...Sensei?
lines.zh: : ……Sensei?

lines.en: : How long have you been stuck in here now?
lines.zh: : 你在这里困了多久了?

lines.en: : I...haven’t really been keeping track...
lines.zh: : 我……没怎么记……

lines.en: : Me neither. And that’s just one of the many pieces of evidence you can use to explain how absent I’ve been when you need me the most.
lines.zh: : 我也没有。而这只是众多证据之一,足以证明:在你最需要我的时候,我有多缺席。

lines.en: : But...that’s not true. You’ve been cleaning...kind of. And you’re cooking for me and-
lines.zh: : 可是……不是这样的。你一直在打扫……勉强算。你还给我做饭,而且——

lines.en: : Microwaving food and picking up things from the convenience store doesn’t count as cooking. And despite you dedicating your entire life to caring for me, I’ve put in virtually no effort at all to return the favor.
lines.zh: : 热剩饭、去便利店买东西,不算做饭。尽管你把整个人生都奉献给了照顾我,我却几乎没有付出任何努力来回报。

lines.en: : I’m not expecting you to return the favor, Sensei. I-
lines.zh: : 我没指望你回报,Sensei。我——

lines.en: : Shut up and let me finish.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴,听我说完。

lines.en: scene knockknockami4

: I want to be a better guardian. But just wanting that is all I’ve been able to do so far. And each day I spend without taking another step in the right direction is another day in a hallway lined with locked doors.
lines.zh: : 我想成为一个更好的监护人。但到目前为止,我能做到的只有「想」。而我在这条路上每混过一天,就是又一天站在一条两侧全是锁着的门的走廊里。

lines.en: : In a...hallway lined with...what? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 在一条两侧全是……什么的走廊里?我没听懂。

lines.en: : You don’t have to get it. The point is, I need to do something. Something more than just wanting to do something or you’ll never leave this room.
lines.zh: : 你不用懂。重点是,我得做点什么。比「想做点什么」更实际的事——不然你永远离不开这间屋子。

lines.en: : Is that what you want?
lines.zh: : 这是你想的吗?

lines.en: : Only if you’re stuck in here with me...
lines.zh: : 只要你也被困在这里面……那正是我想的……

lines.en: : I think I’ve made it pretty apparent with my actions in recent days that that’s not how things are going to be.
lines.zh: : 我想,我最近几天的行动已经把话说得很明白了:事情不会是那样。

lines.en: : I can’t sit still. I like ruining things too much.
lines.zh: : 我坐不住。我太喜欢搞砸一切了。

lines.en: : That’s just how it is for now...
lines.zh: : 现在暂时只能这样……

lines.en: : But one day, we’ll be in this same position again. And you won’t want to leave then.
lines.zh: : 但总有一天,我们会回到今天这个位置。而那时,你不会想离开的。

lines.en: : When that time comes, you’ll stay right here with me.
lines.zh: : 到那时,你就留在这里,陪我。

lines.en: : We’ll grow old and die inside of this house, and no one will find us until we’re both decayed and covered in maggots.
lines.zh: : 我们会在房子里一起变老、一起死去,直到我们都腐烂、爬满蛆虫,才被人发现。

lines.en: : Sounds delightful. No thanks.
lines.zh: : 听着真美好。不用了,谢谢。

lines.en: : I don’t want you to change, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我不想你改变,Sensei。

lines.en: : Not even if it means being better?
lines.zh: : 哪怕改变意味着变好?

lines.en: : You can’t get any better than you are now. You’re perfect for me and I am perfect for you.
lines.zh: : 你现在已经是最好的了,不可能更好。你对我完美,我对你完美。

lines.en: : I can get a lot better, Ami. I just...might need a little assistance in order to do that.
lines.zh: : 我可以好很多,Ami。我只是……也许需要一点点协助才能做到。

lines.en: : Getting assistance from anyone else will just make you worse.
lines.zh: : 从任何别人那里寻求协助,只会让你更糟。

lines.en: : Would it be worse if I could actually cook for you? If I knew what to buy you from the store and you didn’t have to call Niki because you don’t have any faith in me? Would that be worse, Ami?
lines.zh: : 如果我真的会给你做饭了呢?如果我知道该在店里给你买什么、让你不必因为对我毫无信心而打电话给 Niki 呢?那会更糟吗,Ami?

lines.en: : That alone? Of course not...
lines.zh: : 只有那个的话?当然不会……

lines.en: : But that’s not how it would go.
lines.zh: : 但事情不会只停在那里。

lines.en: : Small changes lead to bigger changes. Then bigger changes lead to colossal ones. Then...something, something, butterfly effect.
lines.zh: : 小改变引来大改变。大改变引来巨变。然后……总之,蝴蝶效应什么的。

lines.en: : I don’t want that...
lines.zh: : 我不要那样……

lines.en: : I want my uncle...
lines.zh: : 我要我的叔叔……

lines.en: scene knockknockami2
: Would a father not be better?
lines.zh: : 一个父亲不是更好吗?

lines.en: : Move over. This isn’t a conversation we should have with me just standing here.
lines.zh: : 挪一下。这种对话不适合让我一直站着说。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: scene black
: Move.
scene knockknockami5
: I know you think you’ve failed me, but it’s the other way around. And I’m sorry I ever let things get to that point in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我知道你觉得是你辜负了我,但其实正相反。而让事情走到那一步,我很抱歉。

lines.en: : I want you to be able to count on me. But I also know that counting on me in my current state would be nothing short of idiotic. And even you’re smarter than that.
lines.zh: : 我希望你能够依靠我。但我也知道,指望现在的我,纯属愚蠢。连你都比这聪明。

lines.en: : Are you...making fun of me?
lines.zh: : 你是不是……在取笑我?

lines.en: : Yes. And I’m doing that because I can make fun of you and everything will be fine because that’s how strong our connection is. But even so, there’s something about it that needs to change.
lines.zh: : 是。我取笑你,是因为我们可以互相取笑,而一切依然无恙——这就是我们羁绊的强度。但即便如此,有些东西必须改变。

lines.en: : If I’m ever going to really be there for you, I need to figure out a place to start. And what better place than the middle of the woods?
lines.zh: : 如果我要真正陪在你身边,我得找到一个起点。还有比森林深处更好的起点吗?

lines.en: scene knockknockami6
: Let’s go on a trip. A camping trip, specifically.
lines.zh: : 我们去旅行吧。准确地说,露营。

lines.en: : You...want to go...camping?...
: Yeah. I think it’ll be good for us to get out of the house for a little while. And your friends won’t be around to see you looking like a drowned rat in the middle of the woods.
lines.zh: : 对。我觉得我们该离开家里一阵子。而且你的朋友不会在森林中央看到你落汤鸡的样子。

lines.en: : I...don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 我……不理解。

lines.en: : I want to be more like a parent to you, Ami. You’ve been deprived of a relationship like that for half of your life and that just isn’t fair.
lines.zh: : 我想更像一个「家长」,Ami。你的人生有一半被剥夺了这样的关系,那真的不公平。

lines.en: : It’s no wonder you act so fucking insane all of the time. You never learned how to be normal because I was never there to teach you that.
lines.zh: : 难怪你整天疯疯癫癫。你从没学过怎么正常,因为从来没有人在那里教你。

lines.en: : So you’re...going to teach me how to...put up a tent instead?
lines.zh: : 所以你打算……教我怎么……搭帐篷?

lines.en: : Honestly, I have no idea how to do that myself.
lines.zh: : 说实话,我自己也不会。

lines.en: scene knockknockami7
: Then where the heck are we going to sleep in the middle of the woods?!
lines.zh: : 那我们到底睡在森林中央的哪里?!

lines.en: : We’ll figure it out. I just think we need a fresh start — and I think doing things we wouldn’t normally do otherwise is a...good way to commence that process.
lines.zh: : 车到山前必有路。我只是觉得我们需要一个新的开始——而去做一些我们平时不会做的事,是……开启这个过程的好办法。

lines.en: scene knockknockami8
: I mean...I don’t dislike the idea. It just...doesn’t seem like something you’d come up with on your own.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我不讨厌这个主意。只是……不像你自己能想出来的东西。

lines.en: : What difference does it make if I’m the one who came up with it or not? The fact remains that I want to do this for you. And, to a lesser extent...myself, I guess.
lines.zh: : 是不是我想出来的,有什么区别?事实是我想为你做这件事。其次……为我自己的话,我猜。

lines.en: : But, Sensei...I never went camping with my dad. How does doing that make you more like-
lines.zh: : 可是,Sensei……我和我爸从来没露营过。做这个怎么能让你更像——

lines.en: : Again, it doesn’t matter what it is. I’m sure an uncle could take his niece on a camping trip too. But I don’t think that’s what you want.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍,是什么不重要。我相信叔叔也可以带侄女去露营。但我觉得那不是你想要的。

lines.en: : And it might not even be how you look at me in the first place. I just know that, whatever I am to you, it’s not enough anymore.
lines.zh: : 而且说不定,你对我的定位本来就不是那个。我只是知道:无论我对你来说是什么,都已经不够了。

lines.en: : So, call me a jerk and interpret this however you like, but I want to fix you. And I want you to fix me. And we can’t do that if we stay the way we are now.
lines.zh: : 所以,你要骂我混蛋、随你怎么解读都行——但我想修好你。也想让你修好我。而我们维持现状,就永远做不到。

lines.en: : We both need help, Ami. A lot of it. And we’re too stubborn to ever truly take that from someone else, so we need to rely on each other. Do you think you can do that?
lines.zh: : 我们都需要帮助,Ami。很多帮助。而我们固执到不可能真正从别人那里接受,所以我们只能互相依靠。你觉得你能做到吗?

lines.en: : Of course I can do that. I’ve been doing that for half of my life. But why would you want to get any closer to me when you know how dangerous I am?
lines.zh: : 我当然能。我半辈子都在做这件事。可你明明知道我多危险,为什么还想靠近我?

lines.en: : You’re not dangerous, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你不危险,Ami。

lines.en: scene knockknockami9
: I cut your hand! I threatened all of the other girls at school! I went through your phone! I used it to blackmail people! I’m a bad girl, Sensei! And now you want to reward me for that?! Why?!
lines.zh: : 我划伤了你的手!我在学校威胁了所有女孩!我翻过你的手机!我用它敲诈过人!我是个坏女孩,Sensei!而你现在想奖励我?!为什么?!

lines.en: : Do you really think you’re the only person who’s “bad” here? Because I’ve done my fair share of terrible things as well. So how about we just say they cancel each other out and we can be horrible together?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得这里只有你一个人「坏」吗?因为我也干过相当多的坏事。所以我们不如宣布它们相互抵消,然后一起糟糕下去,如何?

lines.en: scene knockknockami10
: Would you really accept me as a daughter after how hard I’ve made everything for you?...
lines.zh: : 在我把一切弄得那么难之后……你真的还愿意接受我当女儿吗?……

lines.en: : Would you really accept me as a father after I waited for you to go bat-shit crazy before finally deciding to step up?
lines.zh: : 在我一直袖手旁观、等你彻底疯了才终于肯站出来之后……你真的还愿意接受我当父亲吗?

lines.en: scene knockknockami11
: This...is all really surprising to me, Sensei. I’m not sure how to react.
lines.zh: : 这……一切都太让我意外了,Sensei。我不知道该作何反应。

lines.en: : Do you want to go camping or not? I have to know if I should pack your bag, because we’d be leaving in the morning.
lines.zh: : 你到底去不去露营?我得知道该不该收拾你的包,因为我们明早出发。

lines.en: : I’d go anywhere with you. I just...can’t help but shake the feeling that you just want to drop me off in the woods and leave me there to die.
lines.zh: : 你去哪我都去。我只是……忍不住有种感觉:你只是想把我丢在森林里,让我死在那里。

lines.en: : And if that’s what you want, fine. I’ll die. I just don’t want to get my hopes up and then immediately find out that none of this is real.
lines.zh: : 如果那真是你想要的,也行。我死就是了。我只是不想把期待拉满,然后立刻发现这一切都是假的。

lines.en: : Ami, look at me.
lines.zh: : Ami,看着我。

lines.en: scene knockknockami12
: I want you to have a happy life.
lines.zh: : 我想让你拥有幸福的人生。

lines.en: : And I will do whatever it takes to make that happen.
lines.zh: : 而我会不惜一切代价做到。

lines.en: : I don’t need much, Sensei. Just you.
lines.zh: : 我要的不多,Sensei。只要你。

lines.en: : Then you can have me. And I will build you a world where nothing can hurt you anymore.
lines.zh: : 那你就有我。我会为你搭一个世界,让任何东西都再也不能伤害你。

lines.en: : I’ll protect you with all I have, and keep you on the right path even though I can’t ever seem to travel down it myself.
lines.zh: : 我会倾尽所有保护你,把你留在正确的路上——哪怕我自己似乎永远走不上那条路。

lines.en: : I will be exactly what I was meant to be all this time, and you’ll be able to breathe easy knowing that nothing you do will ever make me leave.
lines.zh: : 我会成为我早就该成为的样子,而你可以放心呼吸:无论你做什么,都休想让我离开。

lines.en: : You don’t mean that.
lines.zh: : 你不是认真的。

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 我是。

lines.en: : But what if it’s something really bad?
lines.zh: : 可万一那是很坏很坏的事呢?

lines.en: : We’ll cross that bridge when we come to it.
lines.zh: : 车到桥头自然直。

lines.en: : What if I hurt you again?
lines.zh: : 万一我又伤到你呢?

lines.en: : It’ll heal.
lines.zh: : 会愈合的。

lines.en: : What if it doesn’t?
lines.zh: : 万一愈合不了呢?

lines.en: : Then I’ll have a scar.
lines.zh: : 那我就多一道疤。

lines.en: : But I don’t want you to have any more scars when you already have a million on the inside.
lines.zh: : 可你里面的疤已经够多了,我不想你再多一道外面的。

lines.en: : And the same goes for how I feel about you. But that’s the point of this fresh start and why I’m going to try and be better.
lines.zh: : 我对你的感受也一样。但这正是「新开始」的意义,也是我要努力变好的原因。

lines.en: : Just...please forgive me if I start proposing more things like this as I’ve become desperate enough to start taking suggestions since thinking is hard and I have lost all will to live.
lines.zh: : 只是……拜托,如果我以后又开始提议这种事,请多包涵——我已经绝望到开始接受建议了,毕竟思考很费脑子,而我早已失去了活下去的全部意愿。

lines.en: : Will you really accept me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你真的会接受我吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : Is that even a question? Of course.
lines.zh: : 这还用问?当然。

lines.en: : For better or for worse?
lines.zh: : 无论好坏?

lines.en: : I don’t think things can get much worse than this.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得还能坏到哪去。

lines.en: : In sickness and in health?
lines.zh: : 无论疾病还是健康?

lines.en: : Mostly sickness, I assume. But again, yes.
lines.zh: : 我猜多半是疾病。但再说一遍,是。

lines.en: : I accept you, flaws and all. And I promise that, even when I can’t help but ruin things again in the future, I’ll remain by your side no matter what.
lines.zh: : 我接受你,连同你全部的缺点。而且我保证,哪怕将来我又忍不住搞砸一切,我也绝不离你而去。

lines.en: : You really mean that?
lines.zh: : 你是说真的?

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 我是。

lines.en: : You deserve a proper home. And a proper home has more in it than one little girl and the space that I take up. A proper home has a family.
lines.zh: : 你值得一个像样的家。而像样的家里,装的比一个小女孩和我占的空间要多。像样的家,有家人。

lines.en: : But we’ve been family all along...that’s what I’m so confused about.
lines.zh: : 可我们一直都是家人啊……这正是我想不通的地方。

lines.en: : In nothing but blood. You’ve carried the rest of this “family” on your back. And all I’m trying to do now is take a little of that weight off.
lines.zh: : 徒有其名的家人。这个「家」剩下的部分,一直被你一个人扛着。而我现在想做的,不过是替你卸下一点重量。

lines.en: : You deserve to rest.
lines.zh: : 你值得休息。

lines.en: : So I will ask again-
lines.zh: : 所以我再问一遍——

lines.en: : Yes.
scene knockknockami13
: Yes?
: Yeah...I’ll go.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我去。

lines.en: : But, fair warning...I have no idea what to do. And I’d kind of like to know who gave you this idea in the first place..
lines.zh: : 不过丑话说在前……我完全不懂怎么弄。而且我有点想知道,这主意到底是谁给你出的。

lines.en: : I’ll tell you tomorrow. I have to pack our stuff, and you need to be getting to sleep as well.
lines.zh: : 明天告诉你。我得收拾行李,你也该睡了。

lines.en: scene knockknockami14
: But, wait...wasn’t there something else that you wanted to-
lines.zh: : 可是,等一下……你是不是还有别的事想——

lines.en: : Yeah.
: I don’t have the energy for more than one step at a time, though.
lines.zh: : 但我的电量一次只够走一步。

lines.en: scene black
: And I’m pretty sure that this one would make her proud enough to forgive me for forgoing the next.
lines.zh: : 而我相当确定,走完这一步,足以让她骄傲到原谅我跳过下一步。

lines.en: scene knockknockami15
: Camping, huh?...
: And who was he talking about just now?
lines.zh: : 还有,他刚才说的那个人是谁?

lines.en: : No, I don’t think it was you.
lines.zh: : 不,我觉得不是说你。

lines.en: scene knockknockami16
: But it could be fun. And he’s never called himself that before.
lines.zh: : 不过可能挺好玩的。而且他从来没有那样叫过自己。

lines.en: : You think so?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢?

lines.en: : And if it doesn’t work?...
lines.zh: : 要是不成功呢?……

lines.en: scene knockknockami17
: That’s easy.
lines.zh: : 那简单。

lines.en: scene black
: I can chop it off.
lines.zh: : 我可以把它切掉。

lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!
